```yaml
name: Promote RC to Stable

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      rc_tag:
        description: 'RC tag to promote (e.g., v3.0.0-rc5)'
        required: true

jobs:
  validate:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    outputs:
      rc_tag: ${{ steps.set_rc.outputs.rc_tag }}
      stable_tag: ${{ steps.set_stable.outputs.stable_tag }}
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Set RC tag
        id: set_rc
        run: echo "rc_tag=${{ github.event.inputs.rc_tag }}" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

      - name: Compute stable tag
        id: set_stable
        run: |
          rc="${{ github.event.inputs.rc_tag }}"
          stable="${rc%-rc*}"
          echo "stable_tag=$stable" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

      - name: Validate tags
        run: |
          rc="${{ github.event.inputs.rc_tag }}"
          stable="${{ steps.set_stable.outputs.stable_tag }}"
          if ! git rev-parse -q --verify "refs/tags/$rc" >/dev/null; then
            echo "❌ RC tag $rc does not exist."
            exit 1
          fi
          if git rev-parse -q --verify "refs/tags/$stable" >/dev/null; then
            echo "❌ Stable tag $stable already exists."
            exit 1
          fi
          echo "✅ Validation passed."

  create-stable-tag:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: validate
    env:
      RC_TAG: ${{ needs.validate.outputs.rc_tag }}
      STABLE_TAG: ${{ needs.validate.outputs.stable_tag }}
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Configure git
        run: |
          git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"
          git config user.email "github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
          git remote set-url origin https://x-access-token:${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}@github.com/${{ github.repository }}

      - name: Create stable tag
        run: |
          commit=$(git rev-parse "$RC_TAG")
          git tag -a "$STABLE_TAG" "$commit" -m "Promote $RC_TAG to stable $STABLE_TAG"
          git push origin "$STABLE_TAG"

  retag-docker-images:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: create-stable-tag
    env:
      RC_TAG: ${{ needs.validate.outputs.rc_tag }}
      STABLE_TAG: ${{ needs.validate.outputs.stable_tag }}
    steps:
      - name: Set up Docker Buildx
        uses: docker/setup-buildx-action@v3

      - name: Login to Docker Hub
        uses: docker/login-action@v3
        with:
          username: ${{ secrets.DOCKERHUB_USERNAME }}
          password: ${{ secrets.DOCKERHUB_TOKEN }}

      - name: Retag grafana/beyla
        run: |
          docker buildx imagetools create --tag grafana/beyla:"$STABLE_TAG" grafana/beyla:"$RC_TAG"

      - name: Retag grafana/beyla-k8s-cache
        run: |
          docker buildx imagetools create --tag grafana/beyla-k8s-cache:"$STABLE_TAG" grafana/beyla-k8s-cache:"$RC_TAG"

  generate-release-notes:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: validate
    outputs:
      body: ${{ steps.drafter.outputs.body }}
    steps:
      - name: Generate release notes
        id: drafter
        uses: release-drafter/release-drafter@v6
        with:
          config-name: .github/release-drafter.yml
          name: ${{ needs.validate.outputs.stable_tag }}
          tag: ${{ needs.validate.outputs.stable_tag }}
          publish: false
          latest: false
          prerelease: false
          include-pre-releases: false

  create-stable-release:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: [validate, generate-release-notes]
    env:
      STABLE_TAG: ${{ needs.validate.outputs.stable_tag }}
      RELEASE_NOTES_BODY: ${{ needs.generate-release-notes.outputs.body }}
    outputs:
      html_url: ${{ steps.create_release.outputs.html_url }}
    steps:
      - name: Create stable release
        id: create_release
        uses: actions/create-release@v1
        with:
          tag_name: ${{ env.STABLE_TAG }}
          release_name: ${{ env.STABLE_TAG }}
          body: ${{ env.RELEASE_NOTES_BODY }}
          draft: false
          prerelease: false

  upload-assets:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: [create-stable-release, retag-docker-images]
    env:
      RC_TAG: ${{ needs.validate.outputs.rc_tag }}
      STABLE_TAG: ${{ needs.validate.outputs.stable_tag }}
    steps:
      - name: Install gh CLI
        uses: cli/cli@v2

      - name: Download RC release assets
        run: |
          gh release download "$RC_TAG" --repo ${{ github.repository }} --pattern "*"

      - name: Upload assets to stable release
        uses: svenstaro/upload-release-action@v2
        with:
          repo_token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          file: "*"
          file_glob: true
          tag: ${{ env.STABLE_TAG }}
          overwrite: true
          draft: false
          prerelease: false
          make_latest: true

  summary:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: upload-assets
    env:
      STABLE_TAG: ${{ needs.validate.outputs.stable_tag }}
      RELEASE_URL: ${{ needs.create-stable-release.outputs.html_url }}
    steps:
      - name: Workflow summary
        run: |
          echo "✅ RC promoted to stable release."
          echo "📌 Helm chart and technical docs publication reminders:"
          echo "- Update Helm chart version to $STABLE_TAG"
          echo "- Update documentation to reflect stable release."
          echo "🔗 Release URL: $RELEASE_URL"
```
